data.narrative:
Atmo is a Series A AI & Software company founded by Alex Levy and Johan Mathe that has raised $29.1M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a peer set of four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables spanning private and public markets, including Scale AI ($29.0B Series B), Reflection AI ($25.0B Series A), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B Series B), and Black Forest Labs ($3.2B Series B), with a median peer valuation of $15.3B and a range of $3.2B to $29.0B.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses total capital raised as a proxy baseline ($29.1M) and applies a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier for progression from Series A, implying a valuation of $58.2M. Peer-median analysis directly benchmarks Atmo against the four comparables, yielding a median-implied valuation of $15.3B.

The wide dispersion between methods reflects material uncertainty about Atmo's positioning within the peer cohort. The stage-progression approach yields $49M (low), while peer-median analysis supports $7.7B (median) to $17.6B (high). Stage-progression likely underweights the company given the substantial valuations achieved by Series A and Series B peers. Key uncertainties include revenue traction, unit economics, and whether Atmo's technology differentiation aligns it with higher-valued peers like Reflection AI or lower-valued ones like Black Forest Labs.
